lemma fixed (H : S.Hierarchy) (P : DiffPlan S) (hp : P.Derivatives S) (ho : P.Orientation H.spin)
    (J : Stress S) (C : Conserved P H.spin J) (Y : RawTensor H.spin J)
    {D : ℕ} {R : Series} (hR : Portrait J D R) (a b c d i) (f : Grouping)
    (hf : Far (f i)) (hF : ∀ j, Ends (f j)) (hv : ∀ j, j≠i → Reflects (axes a b c d j) (f j))
    (w : Axis → ℝ) (he : w i=0) (hw : ∀ i,w i ≤ 0) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0<δ) :
    Budget δ (fun n => sent (R a b c d) (mails w f n)) := by
  let e := signsD a b i

proof_context.conclusion: For every index tuple `a b c d`, a far (fixed annular) profile in direction `i` and transverse profiles with the right reflection parities, `sent (R a b c d)` at the shrinking widths is `Budget δ` for every `δ>0`.

lemma one_mode (H : S.Hierarchy) (i : Axis) (B A : Weight L) (e e')
    (hi : Mixed Finset.univ e) (hj : Mixed Finset.univ e') (hb : ∀ i, Own B i (e i)) (ha : ∀ i, Own A i (e' i))
    (hB : ∀ i, Pressed i B) (hA : ∀ i, Pressed i A) (w : Axis→ℝ) (hw : ∀ i,w i ≤ 0)
    (b : Bool) (hbb : signValue b=signValue (e i)*signValue (e' i))
    (f : Grouping) (hf : ∀ i, Ends (f i)) (ht : Reflects b (f i)) (δ : ℝ) (hd : 0<δ) :
    ∃ (s : ℝ) (M : ℕ),1≤s ∧ ∀ m≥M,
      let Z n := update (mails w f n) i (GridTest b m s (mails w f n i))
      (∀ n, Integrable (mixPlot S B A (Z n))) ∧
        Budget δ (fun n => ∫ x,mixPlot S B A (Z n) x) := by
  obtain ⟨g,s,hg,hG,hT,hS,h⟩ := white (f i) b (hf i) ht
  let K (n j) := fuel (w j) n
  have hv n j : 0<K n j := fuel_pos ..

proof_context.conclusion: After replacing one transverse profile by its zero-moment remainder `GridTest`, the mixed pairing integral is `Budget δ`, by the sign walk and the Cauchy-Schwarz pairing.
